verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships a documented MCP server that lets AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT drive inbox and calendar actions (summarize, draft, send, schedule) via a well-documented public interface, which is the closest analog to an AI-native public API. However, there is no traditional public REST/OpenAPI documentation (llms.txt and openapi.json probes both return 404), and every send action requires explicit manual approval, limiting full autonomous programmatic control. Missing for 10: a conventional public REST/OpenAPI spec, evidence of unattended/autonomous API-driven actions without human approval, and independent confirmation of the MCP server's reliability.
